title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown the ground beef with diced onion and garlic.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
Toss with cooked spaghetti and top with parmesan.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti and crisp the chopped bacon.
Whisk eggs with grated parmesan and pepper.
Toss hot pasta with bacon, then the egg mix off heat to form a sauce.

title: Beef Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef and stir in marinara sauce.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.
Bake at 375F for 30 minutes until bubbling.

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Stretch the dough and spread with marinara.
Top with mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil.
Bake at 500F for 10 minutes, then add fresh basil.

title: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Sizzle garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with cooked penne.

title: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Simmer chopped carrot and zucchini in vegetable broth.
Add beans, diced tomatoes and pasta.
Cook until pasta is tender, about 12 minutes.

title: Tomato Mozzarella Salad
instructions: Slice tomato and mozzarella.
Arrange with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and a pinch of salt.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Shred cooked chicken and mix with onion.
Roll into tortillas, top with salsa and cheese.
Bake at 375F for 20 minutes.

title: Veggie Fajitas
instructions: Saute sliced peppers and onion in olive oil.
Warm the black beans and tortillas.
Fill tortillas with the vegetables and beans.

title: Baja Fish Tacos
instructions: Season and pan-sear the cod, then flake.
Warm tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Build tacos with fish, cabbage, salsa and lime.

title: Beef Chili con Carne
instructions: Brown beef with diced onion.
Stir in chili powder, tomatoes and beans.
Simmer 25 minutes until thickened.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook quinoa and mix with beans, corn and salsa.
Halve and seed the peppers, then stuff.
Bake at 375F for 25 minutes.

title: Huevos Rancheros
instructions: Warm tortillas and heat the beans.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Top tortillas with beans, eggs, salsa and avocado.

title: Guacamole & Tortilla Chips
instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Stir in the salsa.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Sear sliced steak in a hot pan.
Add broccoli and garlic, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and serve over rice.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Stir-fry diced chicken until golden.
Add pepper, peanuts and soy sauce.
Toss to coat and serve over rice.

title: Sweet & Sour Chicken
instructions: Brown diced chicken in a wok.
Add pepper, pineapple and a ketchup-vinegar sauce.
Simmer until glossy and serve over rice.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble the egg, then set aside.
Stir-fry chicken, add rice and peas.
Return egg, season with soy sauce.

title: Beef Lo Mein
instructions: Boil the noodles and sear the sliced beef.
Stir-fry the vegetables until crisp-tender.
Toss everything with soy sauce and sesame oil.

title: Mapo Tofu
instructions: Cube tofu and simmer in a garlic-soy sauce.
Add chopped green onion.
Spoon over steamed rice.

title: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Bring broth to a simmer and thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Slowly stream in beaten eggs while stirring.
Garnish with green onion.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry
instructions: Coat chicken in panko and pan-fry until crisp.
Simmer a curry sauce with carrot and curry powder.
Slice the katsu and serve over rice with the sauce.

title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Simmer lentils until soft.
Saute onion, garlic, tomato and cumin, then stir in.
Serve over rice.

title: Matar Paneer
instructions: Brown paneer cubes, then set aside.
Simmer a tomato-garam masala gravy with peas.
Fold in paneer and serve over rice.

title: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast and mash the eggplant.
Saute onion, tomato and garam masala, then fold in eggplant.
Serve over rice.

title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
instructions: Saute onion and stir in tomato and garam masala.
Add kidney beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garam masala, lemon and garlic.
Roast or grill until charred and cooked through.
Rest a few minutes before serving.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
instructions: Brown the lamb and set aside.
Saute onion, tomato and garam masala, return lamb.
Simmer until tender and serve over rice.

title: Lamb Biryani
instructions: Brown lamb with onion and garam masala.
Layer with parboiled basmati rice and yogurt.
Cover and steam until the rice is fluffy.

title: Pad See Ew
instructions: Stir-fry chicken, then push aside and scramble the egg.
Add noodles, broccoli and soy sauce.
Toss over high heat until charred.

title: Massaman Beef Curry
instructions: Brown beef and stir in curry paste.
Add coconut milk and potato, simmer until tender.
Serve over rice.

title: Tom Kha Gai
instructions: Simmer coconut milk with ginger.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms, cook through.
Finish with lime juice.

title: Thai Basil Chicken
instructions: Stir-fry ground chicken until browned.
Add pepper and soy sauce.
Toss with basil and serve over rice.

title: Thai Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Simmer pumpkin in broth until soft.
Blend with coconut milk and curry paste.
Warm through and serve.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber and tomato.
Add olives and crumbled feta.
Dress with olive oil and oregano.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Roast sliced eggplant.
Simmer lamb with tomato, then layer with eggplant.
Top with yogurt and parmesan, bake 25 minutes.

title: Lamb Souvlaki
instructions: Marinate lamb in lemon, garlic and olive oil.
Thread onto skewers and grill.
Serve with rice.

title: Spanish Tortilla
instructions: Soften sliced potato and onion in olive oil.
Stir into beaten eggs and pour back into the pan.
Cook gently, flipping once, until set.

title: Seafood Paella
instructions: Toast rice with pepper, then add broth.
Simmer until nearly absorbed.
Nestle in shrimp and peas, cook until done.

title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
instructions: Brown lamb with onion and cumin.
Add chickpeas and apricots with a little water.
Cover and simmer until the lamb is tender.

title: Chicken Couscous
instructions: Brown chicken with cumin and carrot.
Add chickpeas and a splash of water.
Serve over steamed couscous.

title: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
instructions: Season and roast the chicken, then slice.
Whisk garlic into the yogurt for a sauce.
Build a bowl with rice, chicken, cucumber and yogurt.

title: Koshari
instructions: Cook rice, lentils and pasta separately.
Combine with chickpeas.
Top with a spiced tomato sauce and fried onions.

title: Baba Ganoush & Pita
instructions: Roast eggplant until collapsed, then scoop the flesh.
Mash with tahini and lemon juice.
Serve with warm pita.

title: BBQ Chicken Skewers
instructions: Thread chicken and pepper onto skewers.
Grill, basting with bbq sauce.
Serve with grilled corn.

title: Smoked Beef Brisket Plate
instructions: Slice the smoked brisket and brush with bbq sauce.
Roast the sweet potato.
Plate with slaw.

title: BBQ Chicken Burger
instructions: Grill the chicken and glaze with bbq sauce.
Melt cheddar over the top.
Build the burger with lettuce on a toasted bun.

title: Baked Salmon with Fennel
instructions: Toss fennel and tomatoes with olive oil on a tray.
Lay salmon on top and squeeze over lemon.
Bake at 400F for 18 minutes.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter and saute garlic.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Finish with lemon and parsley.

title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
instructions: Boil potato, green beans and the egg.
Arrange over greens with flaked tuna and olives.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

title: Salmon Avocado Salad
instructions: Pan-sear or flake cooked salmon.
Toss spinach, tomatoes and avocado.
Top with salmon and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Creamy Fish Pie
instructions: Poach cod in milk, then make a simple sauce.
Fold in peas and top with mashed potato.
Bake at 400F for 25 minutes.

title: Szechuan Beef
instructions: Sear sliced beef over high heat.
Add pepper, chili and soy sauce.
Toss and serve over rice.

title: Sichuan Eggplant
instructions: Cube and roast the eggplant until soft.
Stir-fry with garlic, soy sauce and chili.
Serve over rice.

title: Jerk Chicken with Rice & Peas
instructions: Rub chicken with jerk seasoning and roast.
Cook rice with kidney beans and coconut milk.
Serve the chicken over the rice and peas.

title: Spicy Thai Shrimp Noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles until pliable.
Stir-fry shrimp and pepper, add sriracha and soy.
Toss with the noodles.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Whisk flour and baking powder with buttermilk and egg.
Cook ladles of batter on a greased griddle.
Flip once and serve with maple syrup.

title: Classic Cheeseburger
instructions: Form and sear a beef patty.
Melt cheddar over the top.
Build the burger with lettuce and tomato on a toasted bun.
